segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ דְּמוּת צוּרוֹת לְבָנָה הָיוּ לוֹ לְרַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל בְּטַבְלָא וּבְכוֹתֶל בַּעֲלִיָּיתוֹ, שֶׁבָּהֶן מַרְאֶה אֶת הַהֶדְיוֹטוֹת, וְאוֹמֵר: הֲכָזֶה רָאִיתָ אוֹ כָּזֶה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Rabban Gamliel had» a diagram of the different «forms of the moon» drawn «on a tablet» that hung «on the wall of his attic, which he would show to the laymen» who came to testify about the new moon but were unable to describe adequately what they had seen. «And he» would «say» to them: «Did you see» a form «like this or like this?»
